sources: https://www.blm.gov/visit/ivanpah-windsailing-special-recreation-management-area (read 2026-11-26): 'The lake bed is OPEN.'; 'Please call the Ivanpah Windsailing hotline at 760-326-7030 for lake bed conditions and updates.'; 'The dry lake consists of two parts, the East dry lake bed is great for large groups, speed events, long distance events; it can be accessed from behind the California Lottery store. note: Open BLM desert on the east side of Ivanpah Dry Lake, a land-sailing area just south of Primm, NV; the east lake bed is reached from behind the California Lottery store. No facilities. BLM locks the lake-bed gates in wet seasons to protect the surface, and individual non-motorized use of the lake bed needs a BLM permit; the windsailing hotline (760-326-7030) gives conditions. --Claude
summary: Ivanpah Dry Lake East (BLM Needles FO): no recreation.gov listing (first-come, free); BLM's only page is the Ivanpah Windsailing SRMA, which is open but never mentions camping, locks gates in wet seasons and requires a permit for individual lake-bed use; imagery shows no camping at the pin (railroad edge beside a fenced pond); inclusion weak - reviewer's call; website -> SRMA page.
flags: INCLUSION WEAK / DROP CANDIDATE (reviewer's call): the agency page for the area (Ivanpah Windsailing SRMA) does not mention camping at all; it says 'locking the gates during wet seasons' and 'Individual use of the dry lake bed for non-motorized sports is allowed with a permit'. The Needles FO camping list does not include Ivanpah. Only RV LIFE (4 reviews) supports overnight use. On Esri imagery the stored pin (= the RV LIFE point) sits on the playa edge against the railroad, ~50 m from a fenced pond installation, with no camp vehicles or scars in view. If kept, the pin cannot be improved from agency sources.

WEBSITE: https://www.blm.gov/office/needles-field-office -> https://www.blm.gov/visit/ivanpah-windsailing-special-recreation-management-area (the area's own BLM page). Phone 760-326-7000 confirmed (field office); lake-bed hotline 760-326-7030 is in the note.
ACCESS: no 4WD or high-clearance wording from BLM; the playa is driven only when the gates are open (closed in wet seasons). Not an OHV staging camp.
